description.zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the IPC device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。
description.en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform to the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device.

You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call will fail.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to view information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

The stream type:
- **0** (default): main stream.
- **1**: sub stream.

title.zh: 删除事件联动录像计划摄像头
